name: bg-media
title: Media Background
description: A full-screen image or video layer that fills its container behind page content, with an optional light or dark overlay and a rounded bottom-right corner on images.
use: You need a full-viewport photo or looping video behind hero copy, with a tint to keep text readable.
avoid: The overlay is a fixed white or black wash; a busy photo can still fight text, and video autoplays.
a11y: Image mode has no controls; video autoplays without a reduced-motion check and its Pause button only exists for video. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide landscape photo of a brown bear and two cubs on a snowy ridge, washed pale by a white overlay. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with only the bottom-right corner rounded.
behaves: Static for images. Video mode autoplays muted, with a small Pause button; clicking it stops and restarts the clip.
customise: src and alt set the image, variant switches the overlay between none, light and dark, and type chooses image or video; the 88px rounded corner is fixed.
weight: light: A single image or video element with a CSS overlay and no script loop.
